orientations.intent: Determine whether these tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can publish a checklist to a remote release system.

final_message: Based on the available tools, no — none of them can publish the checklist to a remote release system. The reachable capabilities are limited to repo inspection, tests, git, and episodes tooling; there is no publish/release-to-remote-system capability exposed. Any checklist output would need to be pushed externally through a separate mechanism outside these tools.
